name: MetallurgicalAccountingReconciler
tagline: Plant mass balance, two-product recovery, F1/F2/F3 mine-to-mill reconciliation and a controlled month-end close in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete metallurgical accounting app for Canvas and Model-driven apps: monthly feed / concentrate / tailings balance per plant with unaccounted metal against a tolerance, actual vs two-product recovery and metal against target, F1/F2/F3 reconciliation factors for tonnes, grade and metal against the resource model and grade control, and a month-end close board with variance commentary, approval without self-approval and closing in sequence.
features: Status flow Open → Data collected → Balanced → Reviewed → Approved → Closed with rule-checked transitions
Mass and metal balance with closure gauge and tolerance
Actual vs two-product recovery, mass pull, ratio of concentration
Balance adjustment worksheet with reason trail and two-product tonnes
F1/F2/F3 factors for tonnes, grade and metal with warning and alert bands
Variance commentary required for factors outside band
Approval with segregation of duties and sequential close
Bulk status moves with skip reasons, undo, CSV export
Demo mode with 26 fictional monthly periods for two concentrators
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts with bottom view bar
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
